name: Feature request

title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement

## Problem and proposed change

What user problem does this solve, and what is the smallest useful change?

## Scope and contract impact

- [ ] Generic core
- [ ] Hermes adapter
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other:

Does this change the adapter contract, normalized events, privacy behavior, or
public API? If yes, describe the compatibility impact.

## Harness and API mapping

If this involves a harness, name it and link its public APIs. Describe any
session id, event, microphone, TTS, prompt, or audio mapping. If not
applicable, write `N/A`.

## Security and privacy

What microphone, transcript, audio, credential, session, or remote-data risks
exist? What is the safe failure behavior?

## Test strategy

How should this be verified? Include focused tests, build/doctor checks, or a
manual smoke path as appropriate.
